rules.name: Instantaneous Overcurrent Protection
rules.description: Protects against short-circuit currents by tripping instantaneously (typically <1 cycle) when current exceeds the pickup threshold.

rules.name: Time-Delay Overcurrent Protection
rules.description: Protects against sustained thermal overloads. Uses inverse-time curve characteristics to trip if current exceeds pickup value for a defined duration.

rules.name: Transformer Differential Protection
rules.description: Compares primary and secondary currents. Any mismatch indicates an internal transformer winding fault and triggers an instantaneous lockout.

rules.name: Distance/Impedance Protection
rules.description: Measures ratio of voltage to current on transmission lines. Zone 1 trips instantaneously for faults within 80-85% of line length.
